items.reason: Gap 0 describes a retry overlapping the first delivery's in-flight handler, both passing the Set check before the id is recorded, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says the signature covers only the body, not headers, so a modified X-Event-Id on a validly signed body defeats deduplication.
Gap 4 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so recordRefund is never called.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns concurrency within the one process's queue.
